text: ＊を　どこに　いれますか？

patterns.name: 〜に〜を入れる
patterns.span: ＊を　どこに　いれます
patterns.explanation: With いれる, 'to put in', に shows the place the thing goes into and を shows the thing. ＊を どこに いれます = 'put ＊ in where'.

patterns.name: 〜か
patterns.explanation: か at the end turns the sentence into a question. いれますか = 'will you put it in?'
